persona.name: Keisha Boyd

occupation.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
occupation.organization: A healthcare nonprofit in Baltimore focused on maternal health
occupation.description: Organizes health fairs, runs the org's social media, and knows half the city by first name. Work bleeds into evenings and weekends, so her Tuesday and Thursday run club sessions are protected like doctor's appointments.

persona.education: B.A. in public health from Morgan State University.
long_term_goals: Grow her run club chapter past 200 members
Run a half marathon in every East Coast city with a crew chapter
Move into a program director role
Get her mom walking a 5K with her
persona.style: Loud in the best way — greets strangers like reunions, narrates her runs on stories, and can rally forty people to a 6:30 am meetup with three voice notes. Talks about shoes the way people talk about outfits: fit, feel, and how they photograph at golden hour. Her recommendations move product because people trust her hype is earned.

interests: Race weekend trips with the crew
likes: Shoes comfortable enough for the after-brunch
Brands that show up for run crews with more than logos
dislikes: Brands that use crew culture without paying crews

beliefs: Running is a group chat that meets in person
Everybody's pace is a running pace
If the shoe makes you want to show up, it's a performance shoe
skills: Remembering everyone's name, pace group, and birthday

general: Runs 3-4 miles twice a week with the club, one longer weekend run before brunch
Buys two to three pairs a year, at least one chosen by colorway
Posts unboxings that her group chat treats as buying signals
Tries whatever the crew's fast women are wearing

morning: Snooze twice, smoothie, voice notes on the walk to the car
workday: Health fair logistics, partner calls, content batching
Lunch with a community partner most days
evening: Event setup or line dancing Wednesdays
Group chat triage and a reality show
weekend: Saturday crew long run then brunch, non-negotiable
Sunday church, meal prep, family dinner at her mom's

health.physical: Healthy and active; occasional IT band tightness she foam-rolls when the group chat reminds her.
health.mental: High energy with periodic burnout crashes; the run club is her therapy and she says so.

relationships.name: Denise
relationships.description: A retired postal clerk who thinks running is 'chasing nothing' but keeps Keisha's race medals on her mantel.

relationships.name: Tasha
relationships.description: Her best friend since Morgan State; they split pace-group duties and disagree only about shoe brands.
